Mijn uitgangspunt is: Een verbetering moet aan een werkelijke gebruikersbehoefte worden getoetst. Het verhaal maakt het onderwerp concreet: Een bibliotheek verving haar oude catalogus door een nieuwe toepassing. Een relevante duiding is: De oorspronkelijke meting hield een belangrijke gebruikershandeling buiten beeld. Daarmee is niet bewezen dat alle betrokkenen dezelfde bedoeling hadden, of dat deze situatie zonder meer vergelijkbaar is met andere gevallen.

Een serieus tegenargument is dat telkens opnieuw afwegen tijd vraagt en onzekerheid kan vergroten. Algemene afspraken kunnen juist rust en voorspelbaarheid bieden. Dat argument overtuigt mij zolang zulke afspraken geen relevante verschillen verbergen. Mijn voorlopige conclusie is daarom dat een regel of aanpak uitlegbaar én herzienbaar moet blijven. Nieuwe informatie over gevolgen of behoeften kan een andere keuze rechtvaardigen; die verandering hoeft geen willekeur te zijn.
sample.en:
My starting position is: An improvement should be tested against a genuine user need. The story makes the topic concrete: A library replaced its old catalogue with a new application. One relevant interpretation is: The original measurement excluded an important user action. This does not prove everyone involved had the same intention or that this situation is directly comparable to other cases.

A serious counterargument is that repeatedly weighing matters up takes time and can increase uncertainty. General agreements can provide calm and predictability. That argument convinces me as long as those agreements do not conceal relevant differences. My provisional conclusion is therefore that a rule or approach should remain explainable and revisable. New information about consequences or needs can justify a different choice; that change need not be arbitrary.

A serious counterargument is that repeatedly weighing matters up takes time and can increase uncertainty. General agreements can provide calm and predictability. text.en: In his late aunt's writing desk, Wout found an unposted letter to his father, with whom she had not been in contact for years. Een serieus tegenargument is dat telkens opnieuw afwegen tijd vraagt en onzekerheid kan vergroten. Algemene afspraken kunnen juist rust en voorspelbaarheid bieden. One relevant interpretation is: A discrepancy was investigated and documented rather than silently removed. This does not prove everyone involved had the same intention or that this situation is directly comparable to other cases.

A serious counterargument is that repeatedly weighing matters up takes time and can increase uncertainty. General agreements can provide calm and predictability. That argument convinces me as long as those agreements do not conceal relevant differences. My provisional conclusion is therefore that a rule or approach should remain explainable and revisable. My starting position is: A historical account should visibly distinguish source, conjecture and conclusion. The story makes the topic concrete: In the archive, Mila found a proof covered in blue corrections. One relevant interpretation is: The schedule and testimony support the attribution without proving it definitively. This does not prove everyone involved had the same intention or that this situation is directly comparable to other cases.

A serious counterargument is that repeatedly weighing matters up takes time and can increase uncertainty. General agreements can provide calm and predictability. That argument convinces me as long as those agreements do not conceal relevant differences. My provisional conclusion is therefore that a rule or approach should remain explainable and revisable. New information about consequences or needs can justify a different choice; that change need not be arbitrary.

Mijn uitgangspunt is: Een sterk beeld ontslaat de maker niet van verantwoordelijkheid voor de gesuggereerde betekenis. Een serieus tegenargument is dat telkens opnieuw afwegen tijd vraagt en onzekerheid kan vergroten. Algemene afspraken kunnen juist rust en voorspelbaarheid bieden. sample.en:
My starting position is: A powerful image does not relieve its maker of responsibility for the meaning it suggests. The story makes the topic concrete: Jade photographed a busy square for an exhibition. One relevant interpretation is: Selecting a moment influenced which reality the photograph suggested. This does not prove everyone involved had the same intention or that this situation is directly comparable to other cases.

A serious counterargument is that repeatedly weighing matters up takes time and can increase uncertainty. General agreements can provide calm and predictability. That argument convinces me as long as those agreements do not conceal relevant differences. My provisional conclusion is therefore that a rule or approach should remain explainable and revisable. New information about consequences or needs can justify a different choice; that change need not be arbitrary.

One relevant interpretation is: Earlier choices should not completely determine future interests.
